result.summary: This PR stops a node from self-advertising a SOCKS5 proxy's (often a Tor exit node's) IP address as its own reachable address when making outbound clearnet connections through that proxy. It fixes GetLocalAddrForPeer to skip the peer-reported view of our address when the connection is proxied, adds a ResetProxy() test helper, adds regression tests, and updates docs/release notes (including an unrelated fix of stale -proxy=tor syntax from PR #34031).
result.problem: When a node runs both Tor and clearnet via a shared SOCKS5 proxy with listen=1/discover=1 overriding the softer defaults, the proxy's (often a Tor exit node's) IP gets relayed on the network as the node's own address. Author found 55-76% of tor exit node IPs already appear in addrman snapshots, polluting peer address tables with unreachable addresses.

open_concerns: mzumsande: transparent torification (e.g. via Whonix) reroutes traffic externally without touching Bitcoin Core's proxy settings, so this fix would not catch that case; author agrees this is a known gap but says it still helps for explicit proxy misconfiguration cases

result.card: This PR stops Bitcoin Core from self-advertising a SOCKS5 proxy's IP address (often a Tor exit node) as its own reachable address on outbound clearnet connections made through that proxy, when a user has overridden the default listen=0/discover=0 proxy interaction. The author found 55-76% of Tor exit node IPs already present in various addrman snapshots, motivating the fix to reduce unnecessary gossip and connection attempts toward these unreachable addresses. Three members gave concept ACK with supporting data and log verification (0xB10C, naiyoma, mzumsande); mzumsande noted the fix does not address transparent torification setups (e.g. Whonix), which the author accepts as a known limitation. The latest push (2026-09-14) added a code comment, tests, and a release note addressing all prior reviewer requests, leaving the PR ready for review pending a CI restart the author says is due to an unrelated failure. No dependency blocks this PR, though it also fixes a stale doc example broken by the earlier merged PR #34031.
